title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Trial Quality Management in Grassroots People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Trial Quality Management Work of Basic People's Courts

Fa Fa [2010] No. 56

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Trial Quality Management Work of Basic People's Courts of the Supreme People's Court have been discussed and adopted by the Judicial Committee of our Court. They are now issued to you for earnest implementation and prompt forwarding to basic people's courts to strengthen guidance.

December 9, 2010

Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Trial Quality Management Work of Basic People's Courts

Strengthening the trial quality management work of basic people's courts is an important decision of the people's courts in the new era to serve the grassroots, serve the grassroots, and build the grassroots. It is an important measure to give full play to the role of basic people's courts in serving the overall situation and administering justice for the people. It is an important guarantee for further promoting the resolution of social conflicts, innovation in social management, and fair and honest law enforcement. People's courts at all levels must grasp, implement, and excel in this work.

1. Establish clear institutions and allocate sufficient personnel. Where a basic people's court has not separately established a trial management institution, the trial quality management work shall be undertaken by the trial supervision division. Judges who are fair and upright and have rich trial experience shall be selected and assigned to engage in trial quality management work. The judicial committee shall strengthen supervision and guidance over trial quality management work and timely discuss and decide on major matters.

2. Expand the scope and enrich the methods. Effectively strengthen the work of case quality evaluation, carry out routine evaluations in an orderly manner, and inspect each case concluded or enforced by the court one by one or conduct random spot checks, ensuring that each case handler can be checked for corresponding cases. Plan and conduct special evaluations, and carry out special inspections on specific types of cases and specific case handling stages. Implement targeted key evaluations, and inspect each case that may have serious quality problems, such as those where the judgment has been reversed or remanded for retrial by a higher court, analyze the existing problems, and standardize trial and enforcement actions. Strengthen the evaluation of enforcement cases, focusing on checking whether the enforced property and funds are distributed on time and whether enforcement cases concluded by procedural termination comply with the provisions of laws and judicial interpretations.

3. Highlight key points and strengthen prevention. Effectively strengthen the monitoring of trial time limits to ensure the lawful operation of case procedures and prevent the occurrence of improper extensions of time limits. Strengthen the inspection of judgment documents before affixing the seal to avoid typographical errors and ensure the seriousness of effective judgments of the people's courts. Strengthen trial observation to supervise trial etiquette, trial procedures, and the ability to preside over trials. Strengthen supervision over key enforcement nodes such as evaluation, audit, appraisal, and auction, and promptly inspect materials formed by actions such as seizure, impoundment, and compulsory transfer.

4. Improve mechanisms and emphasize results. Establish and improve a mechanism for remedying defects, and promptly remedy any defects in trial quality discovered. Establish and improve a mechanism for rewards and punishments, granting commendations and rewards to those who handle cases with high quality and efficiency, conducting responsibility analysis for cases with quality problems, and transferring those who should be held accountable to the relevant departments for handling. Establish and improve a mechanism for analysis, commentary, and rectification, conducting commentary on common issues and proposing rectification suggestions. Establish and improve a mechanism for summarizing trial experiences and unifying judicial standards, conducting an overall analysis of the overall trial quality situation, and promptly submitting to the judicial committee for discussion and decision when inconsistency in judicial standards within the court is discovered.

5. Promote internal and external interaction and strengthen supervision. Pay attention to listening to the opinions of the parties on trial quality, collect and analyze the opinions of the parties by distributing quality supervision cards, conducting follow-up visits with the parties, and other means. Conduct regular special evaluations of cases protested by the procuratorate, and communicate with the procuratorial authorities on the evaluation results. Actively strengthen contact with deputies to the people's congresses and members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. For cases of widespread local concern or major social impact, invite deputies and members to observe trials, supervise enforcement alongside the cases, and participate in evaluations.

6. Strictly adhere to standards and standardize procedures. Establish scientific quality evaluation standards, and reasonably determine the grade of trial quality based on factors such as the fairness, efficiency, and effectiveness of the case. Highly value objections raised by the relevant trial enforcement personnel or departments, and promptly conduct a reconsideration. If it is discovered that a higher court's reversal or remand for retrial of the court's case is problematic, the matter shall be promptly reported to the higher court.

7. Coordinate overall planning and cooperate with each other. Establish trial enforcement performance files for departments and judges, and use the trial quality situation as an important basis for departmental evaluation and selection of outstanding units and for judges' personal promotion and ranking. If it is discovered that a case is indeed erroneous, it shall be reported to the president to request the judicial committee to discuss and decide on a retrial in accordance with the law. If clues of disciplinary or illegal conduct by judicial personnel are discovered, they shall be promptly transferred to the discipline inspection and supervision departments for investigation.

8. Arm with technology to improve quality and efficiency. Accelerate the construction of the trial quality management network and application support environment, establish an online operation mechanism for trial quality management, and achieve synchronous collection and management of trial information. Accelerate the development and improvement of relevant application software for case quality supervision and management, vigorously promote the application of information technology in trial quality management work, and increase the technological content and level of trial quality management.

9. Link up and down levels, and firmly implement. Basic people's courts shall, in accordance with the requirements of these Opinions and in light of their own circumstances, study, formulate, or improve the trial quality management work mechanism and comprehensively carry out trial quality management work. The departments responsible for trial management functions in higher people's courts shall strengthen guidance over the trial quality management work of basic people's courts. Higher and lower courts may jointly conduct special supervision and inspections, and promptly resolve any problems discovered.

The implementation of these Opinions shall be reported level by level to the Supreme People's Court.
